title: Pure Virtual World
summary: Virtual World cards only, with generic Synchros and staples. Each Virtual World monster summons itself from the hand by targeting a Virtual World card you control and sending a Virtual World card of another card type (Monster, Spell or Trap) from the Deck to the GY. Lulu then searches a card of the third type, Lili mills one, Laolao revives a Virtual World, and Jiji recovers a monster. The Gates are Continuous cards that negate, destroy or revive, and Virtual World City - Kauwloon places one from the Deck. With four Gates out, Kauwloon summons four Virtual World monsters from the Extra Deck. Virtual World Tiger - Fufu, the newest card, attacks directly with two Gates and ignores outside effects with four. The summons limit you to Level/Rank 3 or higher monsters for the turn, so no Links.
